title: Full Stack Engineer (Python / React / Web3 / відрядження за кордоном)
description:
Important: We expect AI tools to be part of your daily workflow. Candidates who primarily rely on traditional development approaches and do not actively use modern AI coding tools are unlikely to be a good fit for this role.

Are you an AI-driven Full Stack Engineer who uses modern AI tools to build faster, ship faster, and solve complex problems more efficiently?
 

At GT Protocol, we're not looking for traditional developers. We're building an AI-first engineering culture where AI is deeply integrated into the development workflow — from architecture and coding to testing, debugging, research, and product delivery.
 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who embraces AI-assisted development and understands how to leverage modern AI tools to maximize productivity and focus on solving real business problems rather than spending time on repetitive tasks.
 

About the Role

You will be working on GT Protocol's AI-powered trading and investment platform, helping build products used by thousands of users across Web3, CeFi, and DeFi ecosystems.
 

This role combines backend development, frontend development, AI integrations, trading infrastructure, blockchain analytics, real-time systems, and modern AI-driven engineering practices.
 

You will participate in designing and building scalable products while actively utilizing AI development tools as part of your daily workflow.
 

What We Expect from an AI-Driven Engineer

  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants as a core part of the development process
  • Experience working with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Windsurf, or similar solutions
  • Ability to effectively use AI for coding, architecture exploration, debugging, code reviews, documentation, testing, and research
  • Strong focus on shipping results rather than maximizing manual coding hours
  • Curiosity and willingness to continuously adapt to new AI-driven development workflows
  • Understanding that AI is a productivity multiplier, not a replacement for engineering fundamentals
     

We believe the future belongs to engineers who can combine strong technical skills with the ability to leverage AI effectively. Our goal is to build a team that operates significantly faster than traditional software teams while maintaining high engineering standards.
 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Participate in the design, development, and maintenance of a sophisticated AI-powered trading platform serving thousands of users worldwide
  • Develop and maintain backend services using Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis
  • Build modern frontend applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind
  • Integrate centralized and decentralized exchanges, blockchain networks, and third-party APIs
  • Design and implement real-time systems using WebSockets, Socket.IO, asyncio, and event-driven architectures
  • Develop AI-powered features, portfolio analytics, trading automation, and market intelligence tools
  • Build and maintain Telegram-based products and AI assistants
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, AI Engineers, and other Developers
  • Participate in architectural decisions, code reviews, and continuous platform improvements
  • Ensure high performance, scalability, and security across all platform components
     

Work Experience

  • 4+ years of commercial software development experience
  • Experience building production-grade web applications and APIs
  • Experience working with cryptocurrency, trading, fintech, Web3, or blockchain products
  • Experience working in distributed remote teams
  • Bachelor's degree will be a plus
     

Required Skills

  • Strong Python knowledge, FastAPI, asyncio, aiohttp, websockets, SQLAlchemy 2.x (async), PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
  • JavaScript, TypeScript, React 18+, Next.js, Redux / Redux-Saga, Tailwind CSS
  • Docker, Docker Swarm, Linux, Git
  • JWT, RBAC, bcrypt, OTP authentication flows
  • aiogram 3, CCXT, web3.py, Solana SDK, Alchemy, CoinGecko, GeckoTerminal APIs
  • Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Windsurf, or similar
  • Experience integrating external APIs
  • Understanding of scalable distributed systems
  • Experience with real-time applications
     

Will Be a Plus

  • Personal projects
  • English – B2+
     

About GT Protocol

GT Protocol (Global Trading Artificial Intelligence) is an AI-powered crypto trading ecosystem founded in 2021 and the ultimate AI infrastructure for trading.

GT Protocol enables users to build, backtest, optimize, launch, and execute trading strategies using fully automated AI-driven bots across centralized and decentralized crypto markets (CEX and DEX). Its products provide AI-powered infrastructure for strategy creation, optimization, backtesting, and automated execution across the crypto trading ecosystem.
 

Why GT Protocol?

— Over 100,000 users worldwide trust our products.

— Our platform combines AI, blockchain, trading infrastructure, and Web3 technologies into a single ecosystem.

— We process millions of market data events and integrate with major exchanges and blockchain networks.

— Our team includes experts from Europe, Asia, and the United States working remotely and collaboratively across multiple time zones.

— GT Protocol is backed by industry-leading investors and partners, including BNB Chain, Animoca Brands, ChainGPT, DAO Maker, CoinPayments, and others.

— We are regularly featured by major crypto and technology media and participate in leading blockchain conferences worldwide.

— You'll work on products at the intersection of AI, fintech, trading, and Web3 while helping shape the future architecture of the platform.

Currently, our team consists of talented professionals located across multiple countries. Our main office is based in Odessa, Ukraine; however, many team members work remotely worldwide.

Join something big — be a part of GT Protocol and help build the future of AI-powered investing.
